items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I didn't get a chance to do too much with Fats. I did some--they featured me some, but that's one of the reasons I didn't stay.

ctx.x: Now with Fats, did Fats feature you much in his band?

I didn't get a chance to do too much with Fats. I did some--they featured me some, but that's one of the reasons I didn't stay. I was so accustomed to being free with Trent, I was completely free there--
(Side B of Tape 4 ends at this point.)
